summary: Expanded the plan to register ralph-overview in all three ai-developer-toolkit marketplace indexes and verify their normalized fields stay in sync.

Updated the Toolbar refactor plan to derive unique workstream chip labels from data.workstream values rather than taskId keys, and aligned the tests, acceptance criteria, verification, and common mistakes guidance.
Updated the plan to preserve MCP import depths as copied and changed verification to confirm both valid depths exist.

Amended the plan to replace workspace and PATH assumptions with the toolkit launcher model, including root launch.cjs MCP startup, plugin-local npm build verification, and absolute plugin-root CLI invocation.

Amended the plan so codexu package scripts call a repo-local bin/ralph-overview.mjs shim that resolves the installed plugin root and delegates by absolute Node path, with docs and verification updated accordingly.

Amended the plan to remove hardcoded script counts, require execution-time enumeration of scripts/lib, correct current counts to 25 non-test .mjs + 24 .d.mts + 22 tests, and include sync-ralph-state.d.mts/test.mjs in copy/remove criteria.
Added codexu package.json workspaces.packages removal for tools/overview-* alongside pnpm-workspace.yaml, with acceptance and verification checks.
Expanded the overview-viewer generalization plan to audit all codexu/codex source hits, including TopLevelSurfaces, CommandList, persistent storage hooks, whatsNew, and styles.
Added the typed OverviewData.ui contract across viewer/MCP types, templates, tests, and codexu overview-data migration requirements so data.ui reads will typecheck.
Added a hard Phase A/B installability gate, a codexu-migration phase-precondition, and split Next Step commands so Phase B cannot start before the plugin is installable from toolkit main.
Replaced the invalid `pnpm typecheck` references with `pnpm -r --if-present typecheck` in the amended plan temp file.
Replaced the vague codexu post-migration dashboard acceptance check with concrete HTTP, chip-rendering, sidecar/schema, HMR, and grep-budget verification steps.
